summary.zh: 下载视频字幕并提取封面图
summary.en: Download YouTube captions and cover images

description.zh: 按链接或视频 ID 抓取字幕与封面图，支持多语言、翻译、章节切分和说话人标注。原始数据会缓存下来，方便之后换格式反复整理。需要联网访问 YouTube。
description.en: Fetches subtitles or cover art for a video by URL or ID, with language selection, translation, chapters and speaker labels. Raw data is cached so you can reformat it later. Requires network access to YouTube.
